action_timeline.rationale: Fresh outer defender; no upper outer hostile may pass during the relocation.

action_timeline.condition: Artillery is dead and all its projectiles have resolved.
Artillery clearance gate passed and Steward's slot was vacated.
Artillery clearance gate passed; Durin is available and affordable for immediate deployment.
Actual cooldown and current redeployment cost satisfied; Lava's slot vacated.
All hostile spawns exhausted, no active hostiles and no unresolved hostile projectiles.
Same complete-clearance gate; both final clearers are available and jointly affordable.
Complete-clearance gate passed; actual redeployment cooldown and cost satisfied.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both medics are deployed, all four approaches remain controlled and no civilian has died.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A lost blocker or medic invalidates later survival, income and queue assumptions.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four interceptions and shared medical coverage.
handoff_requirements: Retain both central operators through the income and defender handoff obligations.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla share central damage.
Midnight and Plume intercept outer approaches and damage eastern roadblocks.
Ansel then Hibiscus treat eligible central injuries.
survival_dependencies: Central vanguards must survive until shared treatment begins.
Outer interception must prevent lethal officer exposure of detained civilians.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery death is recorded and every outstanding artillery projectile resolves.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Surviving artillery threatens civilians and invalidates the western damage and final-release phases.
battle_phases.goal: Kill artillery before western civilian exposure becomes lethal.
handoff_requirements: Durin's scheduled withdrawal must precede Lava deployment.
Do not execute western fragile-caster transitions without actual artillery clearance.
responsibilities: Steward attacks during upper eastern opportunities.
Durin supplies economical initial lower damage.
Fresh Lava inherits lower damage and uses supported attack-speed enhancement.
Both medics share caster, central and mutual treatment.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward deploys with shared medical coverage.
survival_dependencies: Caster healing must precede lethal repeat shells.
Collateral damage and medical selection must remain within actual recovery capacity.
Cardigan inherits upper outer survival before later officer traffic.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Beagle and Spot occupy their assigned tiles with no escaped hostile.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A failed transfer opens a direct leak path and removes the retained-queue premise.
battle_phases.goal: Transfer both central queues to durable three-block defenders.
handoff_requirements: Successor must be affordable and ready before predecessor retreats.
Occupied enemies must remain interceptable during the same-frame exchange.
responsibilities: Vanilla transfers the lower queue to Beagle.
Fang transfers the upper queue to Spot.
Medics retain shared coverage during both transfers.
survival_dependencies: Each predecessor must survive until immediate replacement.
Required DP must exist from the stated surviving income chain.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Spawn schedule exhausted, no active hostiles, zero leaks and no unresolved hostile projectiles.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any leak or civilian death fails acceptance; incomplete clearance forbids western release.
battle_phases.goal: Clear every remaining hostile while protecting both civilians.
handoff_requirements: Keep all four interception duties until complete clearance.
Verify both civilians remain alive before final release.
responsibilities: Gallus and western Durin damage blocked central queues.
Spot and Beagle retain central enemies.
Midnight retains lower outer officers with arts and assigned recovery windows.
battle_phases.start_condition: Artillery clearance permits western arts deployment.
survival_dependencies: Cardigan's unhealed HP and queue capacity must suffice.
Midnight must receive actual recovery when needed.
Western damage operators must survive and prevent central block saturation.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both expected protected targets safely reach their objectives and all acceptance conditions hold.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A missing arrival leaves the operation incomplete; a protected death fails acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Release western detention and obtain both safe-arrival events.
handoff_requirements: Require actual device destruction and two recorded safe arrivals.
Do not terminate on a fixed time horizon.
responsibilities: Redeployed Steward attacks the lower western roadblock.
Continue observing civilian travel after device destruction.
battle_phases.start_condition: Complete hostile and projectile clearance is verified, at or after frame 8100.
survival_dependencies: No hostile or projectile may remain.
Clearers must be available, affordable and able to damage the assigned devices.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward, opening Durin and fresh Lava jointly kill artillery. Elapsed time never substitutes for its death event.
Plume damages eastern detention and intercepts the first upper outer hostile pressure; Cardigan later separates western detention from officers. Final clearers release western detention.
Midnight damages eastern detention, intercepts lower outer officers and maintains separation from western detention. Final clearers release western detention.
Fang then Spot retain upper central enemies; reciprocal opening attacks and subsequent western arts clear the queue.
Vanilla then Beagle retain lower central enemies; shared healing sustains the handoff and western arts clear the queue.
Plume opens and Cardigan inherits upper outer interception. Cardigan has no assumed ordinary medic coverage.
Midnight retains lower outer interception, using two arts windows and Ansel's extended-range recovery opportunities.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper central interception and reciprocal damage.
Opening lower central interception and reciprocal damage.
Lower outer interception and eastern lower roadblock damage.
Opening upper outer interception and eastern upper roadblock damage.
Shared central and caster treatment; extended-range lower outer treatment.
Shared central and caster treatment and treatment of Ansel.
Economical first lower eastern artillery firing opportunity.
Fresh upper outer three-block interception using ordinary attacks.
Fresh second lower artillery attacker, with deployment SP and attack-speed enhancement.
Upper central defender handoff; no unsupported healing credit.
Post-artillery ordinary arts damage against both central queues.
Post-artillery redeployment supporting both central queues.
Fresh upper western roadblock clearer after combat.
Redeployed lower western roadblock clearer after combat.

formation_structure.artillery_geometry: Steward UP and Durin/Lava DOWN cover different portions of the eastern flight segment. Do not count continuous overlap or guaranteed artillery selection.
formation_structure.central_damage_handoff: Eastern casters cover approaching central enemies but do not cover the column-4 blocking tiles. Gallus and the western Durin redeployment explicitly inherit blocked-queue damage after artillery clearance.
formation_structure.civilian_protection: Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Eastern roadblocks receive incidental ordinary attacks from the outer interceptors. Western roadblocks retain civilians until the final release gate.
formation_structure.interception: Four separate ground duties remain active. Central blockers occupy column 4; the later upper outer blocker and lower outer blocker also occupy column 4.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel and Hibiscus cover each other, both central blocking tiles, and both eastern caster tiles in their baseline ranges. Their ordinary ranges exclude the outer blocking tiles. Ansel's supported range extension is assigned to lower outer recovery.
formation_structure.slots: Four ground operators, two medics and two damage operators use eight slots. Every occupied-slot replacement begins with its listed retreat.
formation_structure.spacing: Moving central blockers to column 4 increases their separation from column-6 casters. No supplied splash radius establishes immunity; the adjacent medic remains a possible collateral recipient.

formation_transitions.transition: Complete shared baseline medical coverage before eastern caster deployments.
Replace Plume with fresh Cardigan at [1,4], before later upper outer waves.
Withdraw opening Durin after his first assigned firing interval; start his redeployment cooldown.
Lava inherits the eastern lower firing tile with fresh HP and deployment SP.
Beagle inherits Vanilla's central queue immediately.
Spot inherits Fang's central queue immediately.
Only after artillery death and all its projectiles resolve, exchange Steward for western Gallus.
Only after the artillery gate and Durin's actual cooldown permit, exchange Lava for western Durin.
Only after complete hostile and projectile clearance, exchange western damage operators for roadblock clearers.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator has catalog rarity 1–3 and normal_mode=true. Every deployment uses a listed legal terrain tile and explicit direction.
Never deploy on an active roadblock tile.
Execute a deployment only with its actual cost, cooldown, free tile and free slot satisfied. A failed guard is a failed handoff, not permission to silently skip the duty.
Before post-artillery redeployments, budget initial 10 DP, natural DP, five specified Fang grants and two Vanilla grants only. No refund or unsupported income is required.
Actual healing must sustain each assigned recipient. A HEAL event alone does not prove throughput or successful survival.
Maintain four interception responsibilities through hostile clearance. Never remove a blocker with an occupied queue before its successor can deploy immediately.
Zero protected-target deaths and two safe arrivals are mandatory. Never target civilians or attempt ordinary operator blocking.
Do not expose western replacement casters or release western detention while artillery or its unresolved projectiles remain.
WIN requires remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies; project acceptance additionally requires both protected arrivals and zero protected deaths.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions and shared medical coverage. Central vanguards attack across adjacent lanes.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Any opening death requires reassessing its queue and income; later deployment entries do not repair the missing duty automatically.
pressure_window_responsibilities.protection_dependency: Observe eastern civilian HP and officer contact. A blocked officer must not be assumed unable to attack a nearby civilian.
pressure_window_responsibilities.survival_dependency: Ansel must actually treat the lower central operator after deployment; Hibiscus must survive to complete the shared chain. Removing Lancet advances the two medics by three seconds relative to the prior opening.

pressure_window_responsibilities.damage_dependency: Count observed artillery damage separately from ground and roadblock damage. Unsupported priority and splash benefits contribute zero planned damage.
pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Steward and inexpensive Durin exploit their respective eastern artillery opportunities; both medics share eligible injuries.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: Durin withdraws at 111 seconds; fresh Lava enters at 113 seconds. This is a planned fresh-HP handoff, not an assumed recovery.
pressure_window_responsibilities.survival_dependency: Durin survives only one unhealed 938-damage physical shell with 14 HP. Steward survives one 910-damage shell with 190 HP. Both require sufficient actual treatment before another hit.

pressure_window_responsibilities.damage_dependency: The artillery must receive at least 13000 cumulative effective damage. The supplied record's 5629.66 Steward damage is conditional history, not an inherited contribution.
pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Lava and Steward finish artillery while Beagle and Spot inherit central queues.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: Western fragile casters enter only after artillery death and projectile clearance. If that gate is absent, retain the existing artillery duty and classify the scheduled transition as failed.
pressure_window_responsibilities.survival_dependency: Shared baseline healing supplies about 248 HP/s in aggregate; collateral injuries can exceed that capacity. Healing selection and survival remain required observations.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Maintain all four ground duties and western arts through late officers, paired raiders, armored enemies and surviving queues.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: Spawn exhaustion after the final modeled 211-second spawn does not authorize civilian release. Require no active hostiles and no outstanding hostile projectiles.
pressure_window_responsibilities.survival_dependency: Cardigan uses base HP, defense and three-block capacity; no self-heal is credited. Midnight requires successful recovery opportunities and his second arts window.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Fresh 12F and redeployed Steward destroy the western roadblocks using ordinary modeled arts damage, then observe both civilian arrivals.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: Continue observation beyond 420 seconds if necessary; only two actual safe-arrival events complete protection.
pressure_window_responsibilities.survival_dependency: There must be no hostile pressure. Required roadblock hit counts and completion time remain UNKNOWN.

skill_intents.intent: Only these five grants enter the conservative ledger; Fang must remain alive and deployed through frame 3570. Retire before the next grant.
Budget two +6 grants. No third grant, kill DP or retreat refund funds any mandatory action.
Arts windows at 61–101 and 171–211 seconds; charging pauses during the active forty seconds.
Treatment enhancements at 83,133,183,233 seconds; no passive ATK credit.
Treatment and extended-range windows at 88,148,208 seconds. Verify lower outer treatment rather than assuming selection.
Deployment SP permits activation at 123 seconds. Credit supported attack speed and ordinary modeled arts hits only.
Defense windows at 175 and 245 seconds; no passive DEF credit.
Use supported attack-SP enhanced hits. Do not require unsupported high-defense priority.
Ordinary modeled attacks only; no self-healing, dodge, RES reduction, probabilistic effects or multi-target splash credit.

tactical_thesis: Replace the failed single-medic artillery chain with mutually covered medics and shared caster coverage. Open with reciprocal central vanguards at column 4, use inexpensive Durin before Lava, and replace the exposed outer interceptor before later officers. Fund every mandatory purchase without refunds or Vanilla's failed third income dependency. Preserve four interception duties through final clearance; release western civilian detention only after hostile and projectile clearance. This is an unverified survival and damage hypothesis, with explicit failure gates.
